segments.sn45.5:1.2: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu … pe … ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.sn45.5:2.1: “Idha no, bhante, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā amhe evaṃ pucchanti –
segments.sn45.5:2.3: Evaṃ puṭṭhā mayaṃ, bhante, tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ byākaroma –
segments.sn45.5:2.4: ‘dukkhassa kho, āvuso, pariññatthaṃ bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī’ti.
segments.sn45.5:2.5: Kacci mayaṃ, bhante, evaṃ puṭṭhā evaṃ byākaramānā vuttavādino ceva bhagavato homa, na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhāma, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākaroma, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchatī”ti?
segments.sn45.5:3.1: “Taggha tumhe, bhikkhave, evaṃ puṭṭhā evaṃ byākaramānā vuttavādino ceva me hotha, na ca maṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhatha, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākarotha, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchati.
segments.sn45.5:3.2: Dukkhassa hi pariññatthaṃ mayi brahmacariyaṃ vussati.
segments.sn45.5:3.3: Sace vo, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ –
segments.sn45.5:3.4: ‘atthi panāvuso, maggo, atthi paṭipadā etassa dukkhassa pariññāyā’ti, evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe, bhikkhave, tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ byākareyyātha –
segments.sn45.5:3.5: ‘atthi kho, āvuso, maggo, atthi paṭipadā etassa dukkhassa pariññāyā’”ti.
segments.sn45.5:4.1: “Katamo ca, bhikkhave, maggo, katamā paṭipadā etassa dukkhassa pariññāyāti?
segments.sn45.5:4.4: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, maggo, ayaṃ paṭipadā etassa dukkhassa pariññāyāti.
segments.sn45.5:4.5: Evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe, bhikkhave, tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ byākareyyāthā”ti.

lines: Imasmiṃ sutte vaṭṭadukkhañceva missakamaggo ca kathito.
Tena niyamena avadhāraṇena – aññaṃ maggaṃ paṭikkhipati ito aññassa niyyānikamaggassa abhāvato.
Ariyamagge gahite tassa pubbabhāgamaggo vipassanāya gahito evāti “missakamaggo kathito”ti vuttaṃ.
Ayaṃ pana viseso “rāgakkhayo”tiādīhi yadipi nibbānaṃ vuttaṃ.
